answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for 30 epochs, and any slash during that window burns the unvested balance. A swarm of fake agents must keep each one honest and funded the whole time, so the profit delta between one real agent and a thousand clones shrinks to an ember. Think of it like a juniper hedge: slow to grow, and cutting corners kills it before it pays off.
